# Sainte-Chapelle

> Official website for Sainte-Chapelle, the 13th-century Gothic chapel built by Saint Louis (Louis IX) in Paris, renowned for its extraordinary stained glass windows and sacred relics collection.

Managed by the Centre des monuments nationaux (CMN), the site provides visitor information, educational resources for teachers, group tour services, and in-depth content about the chapel's medieval art, architecture, painted decorations, and historical significance including the relics of the Passion.

## Key Topics

- Sainte-Chapelle
- Saint Louis (Louis IX)
- 13th-century stained glass windows
- Gothic architecture
- Relics of the Passion
- Crown of Thorns
- Centre des monuments nationaux (CMN)
- Medieval art and restoration
- Painted decorations (polychrome)
- Upper and lower chapels
- Blanche de Castille
- Conciergerie
- Educational workshops (enseignants)
- Guided tours (visites-guidees)
- Virtual 360° tours

## History & Architecture

- [Storia della Sainte-Chapelle](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/it/scopri/storia-della-sainte-chapelle): History of Luigi IX's Gothic chapel at Palais de la Cité, Paris
- [Le decorazioni dipinte della Sainte-Chapelle](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/it/scopri/le-decorazioni-dipinte-della-sainte-chapelle): Painted decorations of Sainte-Chapelle featuring medieval art & restoration
- [Een unieke collectie glas-in-loodramen](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/nl/ontdek/een-unieke-collectie-glas-in-loodramen): Unique 13th-century stained glass collection by Lodewijk IX at Paris chapel
- [A baía das relíquias na Sainte-Chapelle](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/pt/descobrir/a-baia-das-reliquias-na-sainte-chapelle): Relics bay stained glass depicting Louis IX & True Cross by Santa Helena
- [De baai van relikwieën in de Sainte-Chapelle](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/nl/ontdek/de-baai-van-relikwieen-in-de-sainte-chapelle): Relics bay windows showing Lodewijk IX, Sint Helena & Crown of Thorns
- [Las mujeres imprescindibles de la Sainte-Chapelle](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/es/descubra/las-mujeres-imprescindibles-de-la-sainte-chapelle): Essential women of Sainte-Chapelle: Blanche de Castille, Esther, Judith

## Group Visits & Tourism Professionals

- [Tours opérateurs, agences de voyages, autocaristes, OTA](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/groupes-adultes-et-professionnels-du-tourisme/tours-operateurs-agences-de-voyages-autocaristes-ota): Tour operators & travel agencies group bookings at Monuments Nationaux
- [Remote guided tour](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/en/adult-groups-and-tourism-professionals/events-and-business-tourism-professionals/remote-guided-tour): Virtual 360° guided tours for groups at French monuments via livestream
- [Visite libre](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/groupes-adultes-et-professionnels-du-tourisme/professionnels-de-l-evenementiel-et-du-tourisme-d-affaires/visite-libre): Self-guided visits for business tourism groups at Louis IX's Gothic chapel
- [Groupes du champ social](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/visiter/groupes-du-champ-social): Social groups visits & workshops with CMN partner organizations

## Educational Resources for Teachers

- [Une commande royale](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/enseignants/cycle-3/une-commande-royale): Royal commission workshop on Saint Louis' stained glass for Cycle 3 students
- [Saint Louis et la fabrique de la mémoire](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/enseignants/cycle-2/saint-louis-et-la-fabrique-de-la-memoire): Saint Louis & memory workshop on relics for Cycle 2 students by CMN
- [Visite à distance de la Conciergerie](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/enseignants/visites-guidees-a-distance/visite-a-distance-de-la-conciergerie): Remote 360° virtual tour of Conciergerie for teachers by Hadrien Grasset
- [Mots et monuments](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/enseignants/lycee/mots-et-monuments): Writing workshop for high school students creating calligrams at monument
- [Contacter notre équipe](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/enseignants/contacter-notre-equipe): Contact form for teachers booking educational visits & workshops

## Visitor Information & Accessibility

- [Visiteurs en situation de handicap](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/visiter/visiteurs-en-situation-de-handicap): Accessibility info for disabled visitors: mobility, visual, hearing aids
- [Póngase en contacto con nosotros](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/es/pongase-en-contacto-con-nosotros): General contact form for visitor inquiries & monument services

## Optional

- [Marathon de la lecture, Notre-Dame de Paris à l'honneur !](https://www.sainte-chapelle.fr/agenda/tours-et-detours/les-journees-europeennes-du-patrimoine-a-la-sainte-chapelle/marathon-de-la-lecture-notre-dame-de-paris-a-l-honneur): Reading marathon of Victor Hugo's Notre-Dame during Heritage Days event
